routes.name: official
routes.instructions: Download the 32 per-bearing archives https://groups.uni-paderborn.de/kat/BearingDataCenter/<B>.rar for B in K001-K006, KA01, KA03-KA09, KA15, KA16, KA22, KA30, KB23, KB24, KB27, KI01, KI03-KI05, KI07, KI08, KI14, KI16-KI18, KI21 (5.4 GB; RAR format, needs unrar, 7z or bsdtar) and unpack each into <raw>/PUBD16/data/ so that files land in <raw>/PUBD16/data/<B>/. The official KB27 archive holds 80 measurements; this benchmark uses only the 35 that the PHMD mirror holds: delete every KB27 .mat file not listed in nextunit/benchmark/checksums/raw/PUBD16.sha256.
